mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in periods of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or neutral when UNRATE is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of RSAFS increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral during periods of INDPRO MoM decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or neutral when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain neutral or negative during periods of HOUST YoY increase.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% and industrial production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral when GDPC1 YoY < 2% and INDPRO MoM < 0%.
